annotations.title: Check if a Spanish tax ID is revoked

description: Checks whether the Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) has revoked or reinstated the tax ID (NIF) of a company, as published in the official gazette (BOE). Returns status REVOKED or REHABILITATED with the date and the BOE link, or null if nothing has been published for that tax ID. A company with a revoked tax ID cannot operate with the Tax Agency and banks cannot process its payments. Works even when the company has no record in search_companies.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834. Spaces and hyphens are accepted.
